__
 
• The error lies in option 4 of the sentence.
 
• Here, we can use "have" in place of "has" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• In Subject-verb agreement, we use a singular verb with a singular noun or pronoun or do verb change as per the tense and a plural verb with a plural noun or pronoun.​

• All the other options are correct.

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

Correct sentence__: ***Southern states __have__ made** an impressive comeback in the latest rankings.*
